*ALL TREES CAN BE SEEN ON GOOGLE STREET VIEW *

Lime T1 (17M high, 600mm dia.) - Reduce the crown of the tree by up to 3 metres and back to the most recent points of reduction. Reason: Cyclical reduction of the tree crown in close proximity to public road, footpath and buildings. Reduction of excessive shading to front garden area.


Lime T2 (17M high, 600mm dia.) - Reduce the crown of the tree by up to 3 metres and back to the most recent points of reduction.  Reason: Cyclical reduction of the tree crown in close proximity to public road, footpath and buildings. Reduction of excessive shading to front garden area.


London Plane T3 (14M high, 800mm dia.) - Reduce the crown of the tree by up to 3 metres and back to the most recent points of reduction.Reason: Cyclical reduction of the tree crown in close proximity to public road, footpath and buildings. Reduction of excessive shading to front garden area.


Ornamental Crab T4 (12M high, 550mm dia.) - Reduce crown overall by up to 5 metres. Reason: Outgrown location in narrow garden, close to wall and buildings. Reduction of excessive shading to the garden.


Fig T5 (12M high, 550mm dia.) - Reduce crown overall by up to 5 metres. Reason: Outgrown location in narrow garden, close to wall and buildings. Reduction of excessive shading to the garden.
